shouldFix.title: The categorical no-existing-gate measurement conflicts with the live G20 and G21 surfaces
shouldFix.finding: authorityClaim, every classes[*].existingGate field, and closestGateScan assert that no live DR-G* cell owns any NT class. The scan dismisses G20 as envelopes/logs/progress and G21 as only crash containment after a component fails, but the live cells are broader. DR-G20's retained evidence expressly includes 'no direct UI/unstructured logs/final authority', and the adopted D-086 naming candidate says its first-party TypeScript-provider harness executes 'No direct rendering, unstructured host logs, or authority escape.' DR-G21's live harness expressly includes malformed inputs, its claim forbids leaking uncommitted authority, and its retained evidence includes candidate discard plus Coverage/D9/UI/exit goldens. The adopted naming candidate repeats the malformed corpus and names the TypeScript/provider-facing D9 containment surface. Those are direct overlaps with the NT inputs and passes: NT-1/2/4/6/7 are unknown frames or extra members, NT-1 requires candidate discard, NT-5 is a Coverage mutation, NT-6 is a D9/exit/HostTermination attempt, and NT-3/4/7 are attempts to escape host authority. The scan may ultimately find an uncovered semantic residue, but it cannot establish 'none' by reducing these gate cells to narrower paraphrases.
shouldFix.impact: The subject's sole positive act is measurement of a gap. Because at least part of that measured gap is already inside named, role-owned condition-4 surfaces, the conclusion that a new DR-G* obligation is required for all seven classes is not supported. The error is conservative and the subject claims no closure or eligibility, so it is not a blocker; it still prevents a zero-finding ACCEPT.
shouldFix.requiredRepair: Re-run the join class by class against each live gate's full Claim, Harness, Required retained evidence, and Owner cells, plus the adopted D-086 executes text. Record G20/G21 ownership where the existing obligation covers the complete NT pass property, record combined or split ownership where it covers only a limb, and identify only the residual that truly needs a new DR-G* obligation. Do not use one blanket closestGateScan result for all seven classes.

summary: REJECT at 0 blockers and 1 SHOULD-FIX. V3 lands both prior Codex repairs: it truthfully says no obligation or owner is named here, frames the artifact as measurement rather than closure, and removes the stale D-086-only route. It also binds nothing, makes no eligibility or SATISFIED claim, authorizes no implementation, and assigns no unsupported property to G10 or any other gate. However, its central measurement that no live gate owns any NT class is not established: the full G20 and G21 cells and their adopted D-086 executes text expressly cover authority escape, malformed provider input, candidate discard, Coverage, and D9/UI/exit surfaces that overlap the retained NTs. A class-by-class full-cell join is required before ACCEPT.
